baseline.description: Ten-year seasonal baseline (default), not a 30-year climate normal

baseline.radiation_aggregation: equal-weight monthly means across selected months/years; not instantaneous or day-weighted seasonal energy

spatial_support.meteorology: Regional source grid (MERRA-2 nominal 0.5 latitude x 0.625 longitude degrees; inspect source headers for changes), not crater/pad wind

spatial_support.point: representative request coordinate; no site-wide or landing-pad survey

evidence.air_density: derived: ideal moist air with Tetens saturation over water; approximate in extreme cold

survey.evidence: survey map-unit estimates; not a local engineering measurement

source.query:
SELECT mu.mukey, mu.muname, l.areasymbol, l.areaname, co.cokey, co.compname, co.compkind,
co.comppct_r, co.taxorder, hz.hzname, hz.hzdept_r, hz.hzdepb_r,
hz.sandtotal_r, hz.silttotal_r, hz.claytotal_r, hz.dbthirdbar_r
FROM mapunit mu INNER JOIN legend l ON l.lkey = mu.lkey INNER JOIN component co ON co.mukey = mu.mukey
LEFT JOIN chorizon hz ON hz.cokey = co.cokey AND hz.hzdept_r < 30
WHERE mu.mukey IN (SELECT mukey FROM SDA_Get_Mukey_from_intersection_with_WktWgs84('POINT(-106.969 31.972)'))
ORDER BY co.comppct_r DESC, co.cokey, hz.hzdept_r
source.spatial_support: map unit intersecting request point; component percentages apply to the map unit, not a mapped pad
source.depth_selection: horizons with upper depth <30 cm; each reported value applies to its full horizon

limitations: High-wind scenario is a real modelled hour near the 95th percentile of hourly speeds, NOT a gust or certified design extreme.
Each scenario preserves joint weather values from one hour; monthly radiation is separate context, never attached as instantaneous scenario flux.
Regional albedo can mix bright dunes/salt/snow with surrounding land; use site-resolved data for detailed heating.
Missing ground properties are null. Do not silently substitute soil type for measured contact physics.
No universal safe-landing threshold is supplied. Vehicle and equipment parameters are required.
